arm_name: Fairino FR5 with the optional J6 +-360 deg + PGC-140 housing from the DH drawing, mount m2: C2 wedge: same 26.6 deg tilt, the gripper on the inclined top face of a wedge bolted to the flange
variant: A: velocity-continuous (C2) periodic cycle; R19 #41 spill fix: the centre strokes (patterns 0 and 1) push to u = 0.06 m instead of 0.10 m; retimed under a joint jerk limit of 8000 deg/s^3

params.stroke: h_scrape_dice with patterns [0, 1] pushing to U1 = 0.06 m (results/r19/stir/spill/keys_short01_u06.json)

hub.note: stroke 0 start (the same state as the #3 cycle); from rest the geometry is run with a ramp (three cycles from rest: 38.972 s)

pre: spatula in hand, jaw sense -1, cart parked at x 0.45
heat <= half while the spatula stops (R15 policy)
nobody within reach of the wok

geometry.dof: 6 arm joints (rad); cart x, base y, base yaw, jaws constant = state_const
geometry.param: s = bench time of the (modified) bench path on the working parts (ds/dt <= 1), nominal time on the returns; q(s) is C2 across every hand-off and around the cycle

limits.A_UR_source: UR guidance, not a datasheet value: "moveJ accelerations should be less than 800deg/sec^2" (Universal Robots staff, https://forum.universal-robots.com/t/maximum-axis-speed-acceleration/13338); for a non-UR arm an ASSUMPTION
limits.jerk: no limit; moving-average filter W=0.1 s (r19smooth.timelaw), peaks reported
limits.jerk_source: A / 0.1 s with A = 800 deg/s^2: the R19_SMOOTH rule "full acceleration in >= 0.1 s" (ASSUMPTION, no OEM value) [E]
limits.A_note: A = min(800, J W / 2): with the moving-average filter W the time law alone adds a jerk up to ~2 A / W

time_law.law: jerk-limited periodic law (middle of 3 unrolled cycles), one period from t = 0 (s = 0) on a 2 ms grid; repeat with t + period, s + length; q(t) = q(s(t)); |d3q/dt3| <= 8000 deg/s^3 on the 2 ms grid

states.note: the certified states (stir scene), <= 4 mm apart, in cycle order

certificate.checker: checker.Checker.check(full=True): MuJoCo contacts + GJK lower-bound certificate (distance.Bounds), 10 mm robot-environment, 5 mm gripper/held-environment, 0 mm self, joint ranges; R11 mesh rule for the held boxes (r19enc_check.meshheld); hit pairs re-measured with the exact convex bound (r19enc_check.one)
certificate.plume_rule: every robot geom except R_gripper_spatula*, R_cart*, R_dock* >= 0 mm from a cylinder of radius 0.20 m about the wok axis, rim .. 1.25 m (r15reach.py / r19stir_save.py), while the heat is on
certificate.spacing: consecutive checked states <= 4 mm apart by point_bound.segment_bound (r19smooth.FastBound, sub-steps <= 0.5 mm)
certificate.scene: r19stir_save.py SCENE=r17 (R17 kitchen: lid rack, spider rest at (1.52, .36), faucet), spatula held 0.45 m, jaw sense -1, cart at x 0.450
